source_note: 关于序列极限的公开问题
callout_id: 关于序列极限的公开问题#9
statement_en: Let $q$ be a positive integer. Let $a_1>0$, and suppose the sequence satisfies the difference equation $$\Delta a_n= \frac{f(n)}{S_n^q}$$ where $f(n)>0$, $f(n)\sim \alpha n^{2\beta}$, and $\beta>\frac{q-1}{2}$. Then $$\lim_{n\to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^{\gamma}} =\left(\frac{\alpha(\gamma+1)^q}{\gamma}\right)^{\frac{1}{q+1}}$$ where $\gamma=\frac{2\beta-q+1}{q+1}$.
key_techniques: asymptotic analysis of nonlinear difference equations
callout_body: 令$q$是正整数，序列$a_1>0$，并且满足差分方程$$\Delta a_n= \frac{f(n)}{S_n^q}$$其中$f(n)>0$并且满足$f(n)\sim \alpha n^{2\beta}$并且$\beta>\frac{q-1}{2}$那么$$\lim_{n\to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^{\gamma}} =\left(\frac{\alpha(\gamma+1)^q}{\gamma}\right)^{\frac{1}{q+1}}$$其中$\gamma=\frac{2\beta-q+1}{q+1}$。
